recipes.name: Mountain Mama's Potato Pancakes
ingredients_raw: 1 pinch salt and pepper to taste

steps.text: Stir together potato flakes, pancake mix, onion, Cheddar cheese, milk, egg, olive oil, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and cayenne pepper in a bowl until well combined.

Grease a griddle or large skillet and place over medium heat. Drop pancakes, 1/4 cup at a time, onto the hot griddle and cook until edges look dry and one bubble appears in the center, about 3 minutes. Flip pancakes and cook until browned on the other side, about 3 more minutes.

raw_recipe.headline: Mountain Mama's Potato Pancakes
raw_recipe.description: These delicious and savory potato pancakes made with instant potatoes, onions, and cheese are easy to make because you start with prepared ingredients.

review.reviewBody: I love potato pancakes but don't always have time for the traditional recipe. This one is very easy and has a good taste. I minced rather than chop the onion. If you need a quick side dish I would recommend these. Try adding some fresh herbs. Thanks for sharing.

I made a few alterations. I don't like cheese and my husband doesn't like onions...so...
 
1/4 dry pancake mix
3/4 instant potatoes
1 cup 2% milk
1 egg beaten
1/2 tsp. garlic salt
1/2 tsp. onion powder
salt and pepper to taste

I let it sit to long and it got thick so I just added a little more milk to make it the right texture. I added 1 tsp. extra virgin olive oil to the pan. 

They were perfect!! Brought back memories of childhood. Thanks for the recipe!!!

These are a staple at my Elk Camp each year. Absolutely a winner. Some of my hunters ask for a tad more onion and the addition of jalapeno peppers. But as written, this recipe is outstanding. Thank you.

These were very simple and fantastic. I followed the directions while mixing but did end up adding about another 1/8 C of flakes in the end because it was too runny. Next time will add more garlic and and chives. I also fried each side longer because they weren't crispy enough for us. Overall we all loved them and will definitely make them again. Thanks for the recipe.

Delicious!!! I used a prepackaged flavored instant potato mix because that was all I had on hand. I increased the bisquick and milk (and a little extra cheese never hurts!) to account for the 1 cup of instant potatoes that came in the mix. I also used green onions instead of regular onion. I didn't add much additional seasoning due to the potatoes already being flavored. Super easy and will definitely be making these again!
Soooo good! I used left over diced potatoes and blended the mixture with a handheld mixer to mash the potatoes a tad. Great recipe!
Really quite good! My kids enjoyed. If you have the pantry staples, it comes together quick. I would prefer less cheese, but that just my preference. Could totally alter this basic recipe to taste.
I liked this a lot! I added some sour cream into the batter as well, and I will probably add bacon next time I make these. And I’ll make them a little smaller...they were filling!
This was quick and easy, but more importantly it was really good. I used buckwheat pancake mix and 1 1/2 tsp of dried onions since that is what I had. I will definitely make these again. Thanks!
Easy way to use up instant potatoes it just doesn’t work for potato pancakes. Lacks texture.

These were delicious and a great way to use up instant mashed potatoes flakes from a cinnamon roll recipe I tried. I used chives instead of onions because that is what I had and I believe we will keep that change. Also, I noticed my first couple were to thick because they don't spread on there own like regular pancakes. I fixed it when I flipped them by pressing down on the cooked side u til they were the right thickness.
Only change I had to make was to add a little bit more liquid. Mine were too thick. Quick, easy and very tasty.

I've been making these for years now. Sometimes for breakfast, tonight it's what's for dinner!!! The family, who can be picky at times, often requests them on Sunday morning! (I just never tried it with the cayenne pepper. Everything else exactly the same.)
I love this recipe. I made it exactly as wriitn.
Needed a little more salt but this came out great
Followed the recipe and it turned out great! Definately watch the pan temperature - medium heat is the key to crisp outsides and steamy/soft insides.

Pretty good! I followed the recipe. I topped pancakes with sour cream. These would be good with a poached egg. Will
Make again and try serving with applesauce like another reviewer suggested.
